name: Klein Derelict / Pristine Slider
description: Klein LoRA slider on derelict to pristine. Contrary to ZIT, Klein is not stuck on a particular "style" of derelict (it does not immediately apply rust on everything it creates) so it's a bit better on that end. The samples weights are -10.0 (derelict) to 3.0 (pristine). Hope you like it!
